items.title: ReacTOD: Bounded Neuro-Symbolic Agentic NLU for Zero-Shot Dialogue State Tracking
items.title_zh: ReacTOD：面向零样本对话状态跟踪的有界神经符号智能体 NLU
items.summary: ReacTOD reformulates natural-language understanding as discrete tool calls inside a bounded, self-correcting ReAct loop, with a symbolic validator enforcing action compliance, schema conformance and coreference consistency. On MultiWOZ 2.1, gpt-oss-20B reached 52.71% joint goal accuracy, 14 points above the previous zero-shot best.

items.title: Auditing Agent Harness Safety
items.title_zh: 审查智能体执行框架的安全性
items.summary: HarnessAudit evaluates complete agent execution trajectories for boundary compliance, execution fidelity and system stability rather than final answers alone. Across ten harness configurations on a 210-task benchmark, it found task completion often diverges from safe execution and that multi-agent setups widen the risk surface.

items.title: Code as Agent Harness
items.title_zh: 代码即智能体运行框架
items.summary: This survey frames code as the operational substrate for agent reasoning, action, environment modeling and execution-based verification, organized into the harness interface, harness mechanisms and multi-agent scaling. It outlines open challenges including evaluation beyond final task success, verification under incomplete feedback and regression-free harness improvement.

items.title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
items.title_zh: CiteVQA：为可信文档智能建立证据归因基准
items.summary: CiteVQA contains 1,897 questions over 711 PDFs that require document models to return element-level bounding-box citations alongside each answer. Auditing 20 multimodal LLMs exposed widespread attribution hallucination, with the best system, Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview, reaching 76.0 strict attributed accuracy.

items.title: Prompting language influences diagnostic reasoning and accuracy of large language models
items.title_zh: 提示语言影响大语言模型的诊断推理与准确性
items.summary: The study compared English and French prompting across five LLMs on 180 clinical vignettes covering 16 specialties, rated by two physicians. Four of five models performed better in English, with mean differences of 0.37-0.91 points, while o3 was the only model showing no overall language effect.

items.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models
items.title_zh: FAGER：文生图模型的事实基础评估与改进
items.summary: FAGER builds a structured factual rubric by combining LLM-based fact proposals with reference-guided visual fact extraction and verification, then converts the rubric into question-answer pairs for VLM evaluation. Across five datasets it outperformed prior metrics on a Factual A/B test and refined text-to-image outputs in a training-free manner.

items.title: Embedding by Elicitation: Dynamic Representations for Bayesian Optimization of System Prompts
items.title_zh: 通过启发式嵌入为系统提示的贝叶斯优化提供动态表示
items.summary: ReElicit uses an LLM to elicit an interpretable feature space for prompts, runs Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization over it, and has the LLM realize selected feature vectors as deployable system prompts, re-eliciting the space as evaluations arrive. Across ten prompt-optimization tasks with a 30-evaluation budget it achieved the strongest aggregate profile among aggregate-only baselines.

items.title: Stress-Testing the Reasoning Competence of LLMs With Proofs Under Minimal Formalism
items.title_zh: 用极简形式化证明压力测试大语言模型的推理能力
items.summary: ProofGrid is a 15-task benchmark suite that scores LLM reasoning through machine-checkable proofs written in NDL, a compact natural-deduction language, rather than final answers. It reports that frontier models handle foundational tasks but stumble on global combinatorial reasoning and low-level proof synthesis.

items.title: Solvita: Enhancing Large Language Models for Competitive Programming via Agentic Evolution
items.title_zh: Solvita：通过智能体进化增强大语言模型的竞赛编程能力
items.summary: Solvita is an agentic evolution framework for competitive programming that enables continuous learning without weight updates to the underlying LLM. It pairs each of its four agents — Planner, Solver, Oracle and Hacker — with a trainable, graph-structured knowledge network.

items.title: Doorman11991/smallcode
items.title_zh: Doorman11991/smallcode：为小参数模型优化的 AI 编程智能体
items.summary: smallcode is a JavaScript AI coding agent optimized for small language models, claiming 87% on an unspecified benchmark with a 4B-active-parameter model. It had 2,028 GitHub stars and 153 forks.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.title_zh: alibaba/open-code-review：阿里大规模实战检验的混合架构代码审查工具
items.summary: Alibaba's open-source code review tool combines deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to post precise line-level comments, shipping multi-language rules for NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL-injection issues. It supports OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and had 48,273 GitHub stars.

items.title: OpenAI and Dell partner to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise enterprise environments
items.title_zh: OpenAI 与 Dell 合作将 Codex 带入混合与本地企业环境
items.summary: OpenAI and Dell announced a partnership to bring Codex to hybrid and on-premise environments, aimed at helping enterprises deploy AI coding agents securely across their data and workflows.

items.title: Reverse engineering Android malware from popular Chinese projectors
items.title_zh: 用自主编程智能体逆向分析中国产热门投影仪中的 Android 恶意软件
items.summary: A blogger pointed an autonomous coding agent at a $35 Chinese-made projector and reverse-engineered the Android malware it found, including a large remote access trojan. The post drew 89 points and 19 comments on Hacker News.
